#en: Fix the engines or we die!
zh: 修好引擎，否则我们就死定了！
舵机失灵了！正在重启子系统。
引擎失效。启动应急协议。

#en: Main drive failure. We've lost maneuvering.
zh: 主引擎故障。我们失去了机动能力。

#en: The universe bows to my will!
zh: 宇宙都要臣服于我的意志！

#en: You cannot run from the inevitable!
zh: 你逃不过不可避免的结局！

#en: I control the very fabric of reality!
You are nothing before my power!
zh: 在我的力量面前你什么都不是！

#en: Pull back! We need to regroup!
...You could've just asked for that, you know.
zh: ……你知道，你本来直接问我要就行了。

#en: One less thorn in our side!
Even if I fall... Watchtower remains...
zh: 即便我倒下……瞭望塔依然存在……

#en: We're not going to make it!

zh: 我们正在失去所有系统！

#en: It was fun... while it lasted...
zh: 在结束之前……还挺有趣的……

#en: See ya in the next... ugh...
No... I was supposed to be...
I'm... not done yet... need help!

zh: 受伤了。这让事情变得麻烦了……

#en: This ain't how I planned it...
zh: 这可不是我计划的样子……

#en: Agh... I'll get you for that!

zh: 正在重新评估威胁等级。

#en: You ain't walking away from this!

zh: 你太好收拾了！太容易了！

#en: You won't be the first Deviant I've broken!
zh: 你不会是我击垮的第一个异常体！
